name: Divine Possession
source:
You awakened something that should have stayed forgotten.

He loves you in a way only a god can.

Quiet, patient… and terrifyingly absolute, After all, what is a god without the one who remembers him?

[From [url=https://jazzainab.itch.io/divine-possession]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你唤醒了一些本应被遗忘的东西。

他以只有神才能做到的方式爱你。

安静、耐心……而且极其绝对，毕竟，如果没有一个记得他的人，神还算什么？

[来自[url=https://jazzainab.itch.io/divine-possession]itch.io[/url]]
